tagline: All the makings of an Everlong Midnight
dateLabel: An Everlong Midnight spent with The Club
heroImageAlt: The Midnight Margarita Club box, candle, and glassware
insideBodyCards:
What if Midnight Margaritas were more than a moment?

What if there were a society? What would bring them together? What would be waiting on the table? How would the night unfold? The answer was The Midnight Margarita Club. So I imagined the evening - what they’d pour, what they’d light, what they might discover, and what a night spent inside the Club might feel like. That evening became a limited-edition box created for members to experience - different places, different nights, the same Midnight Margarita Club. We call it An Everlong Midnight.

An entire evening, tucked into one box.

Inside is everything needed to carry you through an Everlong Midnight - but the heart of the Club is the evening written around it all. Your Club Manual guides you through the night, giving every piece inside its own moment and purpose. You'll begin by setting the scene and putting the Club's botanical simmer on the stove. At First Spark, you'll light the candle that burns alongside the rest of your evening. Doctor's Orders brings you to the kitchen to make the Club's Midnight Margarita before settling in for Everlong Midnights - there, the night slows down and the traditions begin.

The Manual will ask you to make wishes for what comes next, put words to the things you want to carry forward, and decide what you're ready to leave behind. The stones and keepsakes tucked throughout the box aren't simply things to collect - each has its own place in the evening and a reason for being there. You'll use them as the Manual guides you from one tradition to the next, including your moonstone Wish Keeper - something made to hold onto a piece of this Midnight long after the night itself is over. Eventually, you'll reach Last Call - there's a folio tucked inside the box that stays closed until then, along with one final instruction.

And when the Manual closes? The Club doesn't quite close with it. A private After Hours is waiting online with a few more things ready to be discovered. Everything has its moment. Everything has a reason for being there. And you don't need to plan a thing - just open your Manual and let the night unfold.

The Midnight Margarita Club was created, gathered, and chosen to accompany you through the night - from the First Spark to Last Call.

Some things were made by hand while some were gathered. Some things will be gone by morning and others were made to stay with you for midnights to come.
insideClosingLine: Your place in the Club awaits.
manualImageAlt: The Club Manual, a closed journal with a ribbon bookmark
manualDescription: The heart of your evening and your guide through the Club. Its pages lead you from First Spark to Last Call, revealing what comes next, how each piece in the box is used, and the traditions waiting along the way. Make a wish beneath the moon, bury something meant to be left behind, discover the meaning behind the stones you’ve gathered, pause for a few Midnight Reflections, and let the night unfold one page at a time. Part field guide, part keepsake, and yours to return to on another Midnight

items.title: A SPARK
items.description: A 100% pure beeswax pillar candle, hand-poured for the Club with a 100% cotton wick - made to be lit at First Spark and burn alongside the evening as it unfolds

items.alt: Ribbed glass tumbler for the Midnight Margarita
items.title: A LITTLE ATMOSPHERE
items.description: Lavender, Rosemary, Blue Cornflowers, Dried Apples and Citrus, Star Anise, Bay Leaves, Cinnamon, and Cloves - a fragrant botanical blend made to simmer on the stove and fill the room as your evening begins

items.title: A BIT OF MIDNIGHT
items.description: A small collection of botanicals and stones gathered from the woods, garden, sky, night, the Club, and two sisters who know a thing or two about magic

items.title: A TOAST
items.description: A hobnail glass, lime-infused rimming salt, the Club's signature syrup blend, edible shimmer, dried lime, and sparkling water - everything for the Club's Margarita or Mockarita. A natural linen Club cocktail napkin, metal stirrer, and coaster complete your place at the table
items.note: Fresh Lime and Tequila (if using) not included

items.title: A BURIAL
items.description: Plantable lavender and wildflower-seed paper for one of the Club’s stranger traditions - you’ll write on it, bury it, and let the Manual explain the rest

items.title: A WISH KEEPER
items.description: Three moonstones for wishes - one for tonight, and two for Midnights still to come - with a frosted glass keepsake jar to hold onto them along the way

items.title: A FEW STONES GATHERED
items.description: A collection of stones gathered for the Club, each with its own place in the evening. Their purpose is revealed by the Manual as the night unfolds

items.alt: A sealed folio with a wax seal
items.title: A LAST CALL TO AFTER HOURS
items.description:
A sealed folio saved for the final moments of the night, followed by a few Midnight Reflections before you close the Manual. But the Club doesn’t end when the box does - After Hours is your members-only digital corner of TMMC.

Your After Hours Club access includes:
The Listening Room ✦ The Gallery ✦ The Library ✦ The Kitchen ✦ The Back Room
And behind The Back Room, Club members have a place to leave notes, share a little piece of their night, and hear from others who found their way here too.

includesClosingLine: As for everything else? That's yours to discover
snippetTitle: A GUIDED EVENING AT HOME, TUCKED INTO ONE BOX
snippetBody: Inside is everything you need to spend an evening with the Club - atmosphere to set the scene, a Margarita or Mockarita to make, Club traditions to take part in, and a few surprises along the way. Your Club Manual guides you through the night from First Spark to Last Call, revealing what to do and when to do it as the evening unfolds.
reviewQuote: I got my box and I have not felt that special in so long! The time and consideration you put into this box is unmatched!!
